$mouth.name: {{NAME}} — mouth
$mouth.desc: Turf has grown thick over the mound, but the doorstone stands open. Cold air breathes out of the dark, carrying old iron and older dust. {{SIGN}}
$mouth.brief: The barrow-mouth, open to the dark.

$passage.name: {{NAME}} — passage
$passage.desc: A low passage, close enough to touch both walls at once. A beam props the roof, set there long before you, and it has held.
$passage.brief: The low passage, propped by an old beam.

$chamber.name: {{NAME}} — chamber
$chamber.desc: The burial chamber. A verse is cut into the stone at its center, worn thin by grief, and {{WIGHT}} crouches before it, still as the stone itself.
$chamber.brief: The chamber: the verse-stone, and {{WIGHT}} before it.

in.lockedMsg: {{WIGHT}} bars the way, unmoving but not gone.

variants.desc: The burial chamber. The verse-stone stands bare now, and the dust where {{WIGHT}} kept its watch has begun to settle.

actions.label: read the verse-stone (wits)
fx: The verse gives itself up, line by line. {{WIGHT}} does not stir — these words were never meant for it.
The cuts blur, worn past easy reading. {{WIGHT}} has not moved.

actions.label: swear the rest-oath (will)
fx: You swear the old rest-oath over the stone, word for word as it's cut. {{WIGHT}} settles like a held breath let out, and does not rise again.
The oath comes out wrong, a stranger's words in a stranger's mouth. {{WIGHT}} has not moved, and the old covenant marks a rest-oath tried and lost here.
The oath comes out wrong, a stranger's words in a stranger's mouth. {{WIGHT}} has not moved.

actions.label: read the verse-stone over the still dead
fx: With nothing left to keep it, the verse-stone reads plain: a rest-verse for whoever lies here, older than the doors. You say it anyway, for what it is worth to the dead.

$rest.name: {{NAME}} — rest
$rest.desc: A narrow alcove past the chamber, walled in dry stone. Whoever was laid here went with what mattered to them, not what was owed to a king.

actions.label: search the alcove
fx: Tucked into a fold of cloth gone to dust: {{LOOT}}, worn smooth by a thumb that isn't yours.

$loot.name: {{LOOT}}
$loot.hint: a grave-good; nothing more is owed for it

$wight.name: {{WIGHT}}
$wight.desc: Old leather gone to dust over bone, one hand still flat on the stone.
onDeath: {{WIGHT}} comes apart into rag and old bone. The verse-stone stands clear behind it, its grief finally witnessed.
{{WIGHT}} was already still, whatever kept it standing already settled.

$mouth.name: {{NAME}} — mouth
$mouth.desc: Scree fans out from a crack in the rock, hardly wide enough to call a cave. Fresh scat marks the threshold — something uses this, and often. {{SIGN}}
$mouth.brief: A narrow crack in the rock, scored with scat.

$throat.name: {{NAME}} — throat
$throat.desc: The crack narrows, then opens. Claw-marks score both walls at shoulder height, deep enough to catch a fingernail. Ahead, the dark breathes out warm.
$throat.brief: The narrow throat, clawed at shoulder height.

$den.name: {{NAME}} — den
$den.desc: A wide hollow floored in old bone. {{BEAST}} is already on its feet, testing the air — it has heard you, and it will not wait long.
$den.brief: The den, and {{BEAST}} already testing the air.

variants.desc: A wide hollow floored in old bone, {{BEAST}} gone from it now. The air has already begun to lose its warmth.

actions.label: slip past it for the loot (grace)
fx: You go still, and it loses you against the rock — the scrape of claws fades deeper in, hunting something that isn't there.
It's already turned. Too late to be quiet now.

actions.label: search the bone-litter
fx: Among the bone-litter: {{LOOT}}, its owner long past needing it.

$carcass.name: a half-eaten carcass
$carcass.hint: worth more to something hungry than to you

fx: You toss it the carcass. {{BEAST}} is on it before it hits the ground, and doesn't look up again as you go.

$loot.name: {{LOOT}}
$loot.hint: past its owner's needing; nothing is owed on it

$beast.name: {{BEAST}}
$beast.desc: Lean and quick, more hunger than shape in this light.
onDeath: {{BEAST}} goes still. Whatever den-right it was guarding passes to you, for what that's worth to a dead thing.

$base.name: {{NAME}} — base
$base.desc: The tower's foot, half-collapsed, its old door long gone to rot. Steps spiral up into the dark, worn to a shine at their centers by feet none of them remember. {{SIGN}}
$base.brief: The tower's foot, steps spiralling up.

$stair.name: {{NAME}} — stair
$stair.desc: The stair climbs tight and close. Partway up, {{WATCHER}} stands across the steps, and asks its question before you've caught the breath to answer.

variants.desc: The stair climbs tight and close, empty now but for wind finding its way through the cracks.

actions.label: shoulder past it (might)
fx: You put a shoulder into the gap and climb through before it can answer for itself. {{WATCHER}} does not follow.
It gives no ground. You're back on the steps, {{WATCHER}} unmoved.

actions.label: climb past it outside (grace)
fx: You find a handhold past the rail and swing around it entirely. {{WATCHER}} turns to follow the sound, too late.
The stone gives you nothing to hold. You're back on the steps, {{WATCHER}} still there.

$top.name: {{NAME}} — top
$top.desc: The tower's top, roof long gone to weather. From here {{VIEW}}. The wind up here doesn't pause for anyone, least of all you.
$top.brief: The tower's top, wind and a long view.

actions.label: scan the horizon
fx: Wedged in the parapet stones, {{LOOT}} — worth the climb, whatever it once cost to carry up here.

$loot.name: {{LOOT}}
$loot.hint: worth the climb; nothing more is owed on it

$watcher.name: {{WATCHER}}
$watcher.desc: A shape more suggested than seen, holding the step like it still has orders to.

topics.label: answer its question (wits)
topics.say: What is it you carry up my stair?
fx: Your answer lands true, and {{WATCHER}} steps aside, its question finally spent.
{{WATCHER}} is not satisfied, and does not move — and something in the old watch marks a stranger's answer tried, and refused, here.
{{WATCHER}} is not satisfied, and does not move.

topics.label: bluff an answer (will)
topics.say: What is it you carry up my stair?
fx: You answer like you've always known it. {{WATCHER}} can't tell the lie from the truth, and lets you by.
{{WATCHER}} sees through it plainly, and does not move — the old watch remembers a stranger's bluff, and is not fooled twice.
{{WATCHER}} sees through it plainly, and does not move.

$adit.name: {{NAME}} — adit
$adit.desc: The mine's mouth, timbered and sagging, propped by hands long gone. Somewhere below, water drips onto stone in a rhythm nobody set right. {{SIGN}}

$gallery.name: {{NAME}} — gallery
$gallery.desc: A cut gallery, roof-props leaning at angles none of them were cut for. The gray pools in the low spots like standing water, and doesn't stir as you pass.
$gallery.brief: The gallery, its props leaning wrong.

actions.label: shore up the props (might)
fx: You wedge the new prop home and the roof settles, groaning once, then quiet. This gallery will hold, whatever else is wrong down here.
The prop slips before it bites. You're no closer to trusting this roof.

$face.name: {{NAME}} — face
$face.desc: The working face, pick-marks frozen mid-swing in the last vein anyone cut. A ledger lies open on an upturned crate, its ink long since run.
$face.brief: The working face, a ledger left open.

actions.label: puzzle out the ledger (wits)
fx: The tallies make an ugly sense once followed: corners cut, timber skipped, signed off anyway. Worth knowing, whatever else waits down here.
The figures swim, half of them water-stained past reading.

$deep.name: {{NAME}} — deep
$deep.desc: The gray pools thicker here than anywhere else in the mine, ankle-deep and still. {{FOREMAN}} stands in the middle of it, waiting on an answer nobody's given him.
$deep.brief: The deep, and {{FOREMAN}} waiting in the gray.

variants.desc: The gray has thinned here, though it hasn't left. {{FOREMAN}} is gone from the deep, whatever he waited for finally said.

actions.label: search the flooded cut
fx: Where the water's shallowest: {{LOOT}}, small mercy, but yours now.

$loot.name: {{LOOT}}
$loot.hint: small mercy, and yours now; nothing is owed on it

$foreman.name: {{FOREMAN}}
$foreman.desc: Chalk-dust pale, turning a dead lamp over and over in his hands.

topics.label: why does the gray pool here
topics.say: Grief finds the low places, same as water. Mine's got plenty of both, and no drain for either.

topics.label: promise to finish it (will)
topics.say: Say it plain, then. Say you'll see it done.
fx: You give him the words he's waited on. Something in {{FOREMAN}} finally settles, the lamp gone still in his hands.
The words come out thin. {{FOREMAN}} looks through you like you hadn't spoken — and the company hears a promise made, and broken, here.
The words come out thin. {{FOREMAN}} looks through you like you hadn't spoken at all.

$palisade.name: {{NAME}} — palisade
$palisade.desc: A ring of sharpened stakes and old rope, more scarecrow than wall, but it's kept someone out before. A watch-fire glows just inside. {{SIGN}}
$palisade.brief: A stake-and-rope palisade, a watch-fire glowing within.

$fire.name: {{NAME}} — fire
$fire.desc: Bedrolls and a cookpot ring the fire. {{CAPTAIN}} stands to meet you before anyone else moves, hand loose on a belt-knife, already naming what {{NAME}} charges to pass.
$fire.brief: The fire-ring, and {{CAPTAIN}} naming a price.

in.hint: pay, fight, talk, or slip past {{CAPTAIN}} first

variants.desc: Bedrolls and a cookpot ring the fire, banked low for the night. {{CAPTAIN}} waves you through without looking up this time.

actions.label: pay the toll (gold)
fx: {{CAPTAIN}} weighs the coin in one hand, then waves you toward the fire like you were always welcome there.

actions.label: slip through unseen (grace)
fx: You wait for the watch to turn and thread the gap between bedrolls before anyone thinks to look twice.
Someone looks up right as you move. {{CAPTAIN}} hasn't missed it.

$tent.name: {{NAME}} — tent
$tent.desc: {{CAPTAIN}}'s own tent, patched canvas over a strongbox that's seen rougher roads than this one. Whatever the company hasn't spent yet is in here.

actions.label: take a share from the box
fx: A share left plain on top, like {{CAPTAIN}} expected someone to come looking. You take it and nothing more.

$loot.name: {{LOOT}}
$loot.hint: a share of the take; nothing more is owed on it

$captain.name: {{CAPTAIN}}
$captain.desc: Watches you add up the way anyone who runs {{NAME}} learns to — quick, and without apology.

topics.label: what's the toll
topics.say: Everyone pays something to use this road. Coin's simplest, if you've got it. Otherwise we'll find out what else you're carrying.

topics.label: talk the toll down (will)
topics.say: Go on, then. Make your case.
fx: You make a case {{CAPTAIN}} can't quite argue with, and they wave you past, calling it fair enough.
{{CAPTAIN}} hears you out, unmoved, and says as much — and the company remembers a stranger's plea that didn't land.
{{CAPTAIN}} hears you out, unmoved, and says as much without much interest.

onDeath: {{CAPTAIN}} goes down still reaching for the knife. The rest of the camp doesn't move to avenge it — a toll's a toll, not a cause.

$porch.name: {{NAME}} — porch
$porch.desc: Rain has had its way with the porch roof, but the door beneath it still hangs true. Old wax has pooled and hardened on the sill, layer over layer. {{SIGN}}
$porch.brief: The chapel porch, wax pooled on the sill.

$nave.name: {{NAME}} — nave
$nave.desc: Pews gone to moss, and at the altar {{SAINT}} kneels still, unrested, keeping a vigil nobody relieved. It looks up at your step on the flagstones.
$nave.brief: The nave, and {{SAINT}} still kneeling at the altar.

in.lockedMsg: {{SAINT}} kneels across the crypt stair, and will not be stepped around.
in.hint: rite, reading, or force past {{SAINT}} first

variants.desc: Pews gone to moss. The altar stands empty now, and the flagstones hold a little less cold than they did.
variants.brief: The nave, the altar empty now.

actions.label: speak the rite for it (will)
fx: You speak the rite whole, start to finish, meaning enough of it that {{SAINT}} finally hears the end of its own vigil.
The words come out hollow, half-remembered. {{SAINT}} does not stir — and the Church hears a rite tried here, and lost.
The words come out hollow, half-remembered. {{SAINT}} does not stir.

actions.label: read the vigil-plaque (wits)
fx: The plaque names the vigil's proper end, word for word. {{SAINT}} rises, and does not kneel again.
The plaque's cut too shallow to read by feel alone, and you're guessing more than reading.

$crypt.name: {{NAME}} — crypt
$crypt.desc: The crypt below, close-walled and dry, holds the congregation the nave forgot, and on the one dry shelf sits {{LOOT}}, waiting on someone to claim it.

actions.label: lay them to rest
fx: You say what's owed to the ones the nave forgot, plain and unhurried, and {{LOOT}} comes free after, like it was only waiting to be asked.

actions.label: take {{LOOT}} and go
fx: You pry {{LOOT}} loose and pocket it. The congregation's rest is no better and no worse for your being quick about it.

variants.desc: The crypt lies quiet now, the congregation settled at last; the shelf that held {{LOOT}} stands bare.
variants.brief: The crypt, quiet, the shelf bare.

variants.desc: The crypt stands picked over, {{LOOT}} long gone from its shelf; the congregation's bones lie exactly as they were left.
variants.brief: The crypt, picked over, the dead untouched.

$loot.name: {{LOOT}}
$loot.hint: a keepsake now, however it came; nothing is owed on it

$saint_shade.name: {{SAINT}}
$saint_shade.desc: Robes gone to cobweb, hands still folded as if the prayer never ended.
onDeath: {{SAINT}} comes apart into dust and old cloth, its vigil finally ended, however roughly.

$hut.name: {{NAME}}
$hut.desc: One room: a hearth, a cot, and {{HERMIT}} mid-task at a bench, in no hurry to notice you. Everything here has been mended, more than once, and holds. {{SIGN}}
$hut.brief: {{HERMIT}}'s one room, everything mended more than once.

variants.desc: One room: a hearth, a cot, {{HERMIT}} back at the bench like nothing was asked. The mended things still hold.

actions.label: press for it plainly (might)
fx: You make it plain you're not leaving without an answer. {{HERMIT}} decides you mean it, and talks.
{{HERMIT}} waits you out, unbothered. You gave in first.

actions.label: read the signs yourself (wits)
fx: It's all there if you look: what's worn, what's new, what's kept close. You piece it together without a word asked.
Whatever's here to read, it doesn't give itself up on a glance.

actions.label: take the parting gift
fx: {{HERMIT}} presses it into your hands before you can think to refuse, already turning back to the bench.

$loot.name: {{LOOT}}
$loot.hint: a parting gift; nothing is owed on it

$hermit.name: {{HERMIT}}
$hermit.desc: {{HERMIT}}: doesn't look up first. Looks up eventually, and takes your measure quick.

topics.label: ask what {{HERMIT}} needs
topics.say: Everyone wants something, coming this far out. What's yours?

topics.label: offer to help, in trade (will)
topics.say: Fair enough. Talk, then, and we'll see.
fx: You strike a plain bargain, and {{HERMIT}} keeps to it, telling you what you came for without further prompting.
{{HERMIT}} hears you out and shakes their head. Not enough, not yet.

statusTracks.label: Crypts of the dead laid to rest

epilogue.text: Chapel crypts keep coming up looted across the Reach, no rite spoken, no name left for the taking.
Three chapels or more, they say, where a stranger spoke the proper rite before taking what the dead no longer needed.
